wiki_text: Since 2025 the Hong Kong Offshore LNG Terminal (Bauhinia Spirit FSRU, east of the Soko Islands) has additionally functioned as a base for ship-to-ship LNG bunkering of ocean-going vessels, run via a CLPe (CLP Group)–CNOOC joint venture. The first VLCC LNG bunkering in Hong Kong waters was completed at South Cheung Chau Anchorage on 24 Feb 2026 (~4,700 m3 to the VLCC Maran Dione), and a June 2025 operation delivered ~10,000 m3 to the containership Hanoi Express at Kwai Tsing during simultaneous cargo handling, using CNOOC's bunkering vessel Haiyang Shiyou 301. This is a bunkering/service role layered onto the existing import terminal, not a separate GEM terminal.
